title: orthoraphium coreanum subsp. kengii
intro: Orthoraphium coreanum subsp. kengii, commonly known as Korean angelica or Keng's angelica, is a subspecies of plant in the carrot family, native to East Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Orthoraphium coreanum subsp. kengii include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and lignans, which contribute to its therapeutic and medicinal effects.
